assumptions.vehicleRule: WH-01-VH-001…005 = 6×4 tractor + 13.6 m semitrailer; WH-06-VH-001…002 = whR1VehicleForSite delivery-train; WH-06-VH-003…004 = whR1VehicleForSite delivery-tricycle; train radius 7 m, tricycle radius 4 m
assumptions.entranceRule: SITE 临街物流出入口 → 东侧外部等待区 → 建筑外调车区；不穿主仓或附建区
assumptions.doors: target door excluded only for final bay; all other doors/door sweeps are UNKNOWN static obstacles
assumptions.occupancy: adjacentEmpty / adjacentOccupied / simultaneousM5 are all measured; status is the minimum over the three
assumptions.method: articulated tractor/trailer or rigid delivery vehicle polygons sampled at ≤0.25 m; sweptEnvelope is the union of each sampled polygon, never a route convex hull; expanded SITE geometry, annex, I7 fixtures and occupied bays included
